title: Tech Note: Fuzzy Tools Component
author: David Adams
featured_technology: Edit distance and Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) algorithms

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the public API of the FuzzyTools component, a compiled-methods 4D component wrapping classic phonetic (Soundex variants, Metaphone) and string-distance (edit distance, LCS) fuzzy-matching algorithms behind a small, error-checked gateway interface. As a component-design case study (protected gateway routines validating inputs before dispatching to private workers) it is a still-relevant pattern, and the fuzzy-matching algorithms themselves are timeless computer science, but the component and its exact method names are a third-party 4D 2004-era artifact that would need to be sourced or reimplemented for use in any modern 4D application, especially one using 4D's native SQL engine (introduced in v11, 2007) or built-in string functions that may now cover some of this ground.
related_updates: FuzzyTools is a compiled-component add-on from the 4D 2004 era, not a built-in or currently distributed 4D feature
4D v11 (2007) later introduced 4D's native SQL engine, which along with modern 4D language additions may offer alternative approaches to some string-matching tasks
